section: 2. Tracking Spring Energy: First Encounter and Probing
description: The group follows the Spring Energy light points on their journey, encountering their first battle along the way. Each character demonstrates their abilities, and the beginnings of teamwork emerge.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Looks like my ability isn't strong enough to locate something that far away.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Sorry, maybe we'll just have to walk there first."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "No problem, I know the way pretty well, and we can even buy some snacks along the way."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Then let's set off."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Walk ahead to lead the way, while also taking a look around at the surroundings.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Passing through the Snow Gate, the first thing you hear is a "crunching" sound. The snow layer underfoot is very thick and feels fluffy when stepped on. Dry branches snap crisply under your boots, and goose-feather-like snowflakes continuously slide off the pine branches. The depths of the Birch Forest are very dark, growing darker the further you go, seemingly endless. Accompanying you are still the pink light points, flying towards the depths.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Is all this the life force that's been drained...?" Hope the Sunflower Field is okay.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "My grove..."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #It's all the same to Ge Qing, keep walking.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Where do you live, Miss Lina?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: You chat as you walk deeper in.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "A Cherry Grove recently grew next to the Sunflower Field, and I live there."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Huh? The Sunflower Field? I live there too!" #Looking very surprised. "Then we can meet often!" "Um, would that bother you, Miss Lina?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Not at all, I get a bit bored alone in the grove sometimes."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Then... can I come chat with you, Miss Lina?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "If we can resolve the incident, you're welcome anytime!"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Miss Yuuka usually doesn't seem to like talking much..." "Great, great! Then let's work hard together! I'll do my best not to hold everyone back!"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "I'd like to ask, have you seen a very suspicious-looking blonde woman?"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "...Black and white one?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Blonde woman?" #Thinking for a moment. "I don't think I've seen one."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "I occasionally see a black-and-white blonde child stealing my cherries."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Not a child, a lady."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Then I don't have any impression of that."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Haven't seen one."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "It seems like youkai are all pretty big, right...?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: A voice from an unknown location.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Ahhhhh!" #Startled.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Who's there?" #Look towards the direction of the sound.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The voice seems to come from nowhere, but what can be felt is...

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Eek!" #Covers head and lies flat on the ground.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: It seems to be deep in the forest. "Hehe." It seems to be amused by Lina's appearance.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Y-you, who are you!" #Shouting with mustered courage.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #Sense the flow of emotions.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Could you please show yourself?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "You there?" "Who am I..."

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: [Observer Ge Qing]'s 'Soul Hunt' check: Roll: 1D20+3d4=12+{1+1+1}(3)=15 Challenge: 10 Success Success Level: 1

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: .sh3d4

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Come find me!"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "You can't define your own existence?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The voice carries excitement. In Ge Qing's mind's eye, the emotions contain a mischievous excitement.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Long'er, with dead-fish eyes, sighs helplessly.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: That cluster of emotional energy is not far from you. It looks small. "Huh... I don't understand." Deep in the forest, the voice continues. It's a young girl's voice. Even in Gensokyo, girls of that age are rare. "Why not come see for yourself—"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #Walk directly towards it.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The girl says this.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Do you think it might be a man-eating youkai in disguise..." #Recalling childhood stories of youkai eating people, becoming even more scared.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Hehehe..." The girl laughs like this. And Ge Qing leads everyone deeper in first.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "So scary, are you trying to scare me?" #Following Ge Qing.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Wait for me..." #Crawling forward on the ground.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Following behind fearfully.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The deeper you go into the forest, the denser the floating Spring Energy light points become in the air. These pale pink lights give the snow a coral-like texture. The entire Birch Forest is so quiet only breathing can be heard, all tree trunks adorned with translucent icicles. You head towards the deepest part of the forest. Those light points sink into the ground, flowing underground. And the voice is very, very close to you now. "Closer, closer—"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "I, I'm a little scared..."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The voice tempts like this. "Hehehe."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Could this be some disguised youkai?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "What do you think, hehe." #Amused by Xueyu's words.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: As you get closer, you can feel the source of the voice is above you— Just then, a pair of legs clad in black stockings suddenly dangle down from the snow-laden tree canopy. "Wah!!!"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #Can't see.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: A girl hangs herself upside down from a birch branch with a red ribbon. Her short golden hair hangs down like inverted wheat stalks. Her crimson pupils curve into crescents on her inverted face: "Wah—!" The small mouth she opens reveals sharp fangs. The surrounding light dims slightly, but the smile lines at the corners of her mouth, which she can barely hold back, expose this as purely a prank.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Wahhhhhhhhh!" #Starts screaming.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "...What's wrong?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Hahahahaha!"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: “I can't see, I can't see...” #Burying head in snow to escape reality

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: “The blonde lady I'm looking for definitely isn't you.”

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: “There's, there's a monster ahhhhhhhhh”

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The dusk fairy Rumia

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: “Huh?” #Staring blankly at the other person “I, I think I've seen you before...”

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: “Huh?”

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: “When I went to that stall run by the Night Sparrow boss before...” #Timidly hides a bit behind the nearest tree

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: “The Night Sparrow proprietress...”

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: “If only she were a fairy too...” #Looks up

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: “I'm a man-eating fairy, Rumia”

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: “No... please don't eat her... the feast, no, I still want to go there to eat...” #Hiding behind the tree

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: “Eat people?” #Frowning

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: “No”

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: “Won't you get eaten by the shrine maiden if you eat people?”

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: “The shrine maiden?”

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: “Fairies preying on humans is the rule in Gensokyo.”

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: “Mhm mhm”

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: “Probably.”

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: “It's the rule”

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: “But I think you probably can't beat the Hakurei head.”

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: “What kind of nonsense is that”

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: “What's this, are you looking down on me (。-`ω´-)”

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: “Who are you again.”

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: “With the recent heavy snow, the nighttime has gotten longer”

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: “Please, please don't eat me” #Eyes moistening

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: “I already said”

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: “Stop the tough talk, I have something I want to ask the fairy”

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: “Huh?”

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: “Grr... I'm actually getting weaker and weaker now”

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: She points at herself

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Mi... Miss Lina?" #asks worriedly "Are you alright?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Sorry, are you the most powerful fairy Rumia?"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "It's snowing heavily even though it's spring. I wanted to visit the winter and spring fairies..."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "That's me"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Human lives are far shorter than yours. Could you wait until we die before eating us?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Lily White?" #asks in confusion

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "At least there's no answer yet, I'd say"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Alright"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Thank you for your mercy." #bows in courtesy

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Hmm, living near the Sunflower Field, huh"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Sunflower Field..."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "I was just that——close"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Sun... flower Field?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "You actually didn't see me"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Seems I need to walk around more from now on..."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Rumia paces back and forth below

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "That sure sounds lively"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "She's a very cute child"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #still hiding fearfully behind the tree

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Come out, Rumia won't eat you"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Wahhhhhhhhh" #startled

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "So strange..."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Boss Rumia, don't scare her, the kid's timid."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "So, did everyone come to play with Rumia?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "I, I'm here to end this disaster!"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: She climbs up the tree with her little legs

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "The life force around here is being constantly drained by something underground."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Eh~"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "If that's the case, all the plants will wither"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Sounds so boring"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "In that case, even the flower field won't bloom anymore..."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Why not play with me instead?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Then, how about I play a little game with you, Lady Rumia."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: She excitedly jumps down from the tree.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #Mentally debating whether to just leave.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "This thing is called a card." #Takes out a deck of playing cards from the pocket, and while walking forward, hands Rumia a Queen of Spades.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Hmm... huh?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Interacting with youkai feels so difficult... I won't get suddenly eaten, will I... Sunshi, you must save me QAQ.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Let's play a little game called Blackjack." #Explains the rules of Blackjack to Rumia.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "No."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "...Okay."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Rumia seeks, everyone hides."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "What happens if we lose?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "That could work too."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Stay and play with Rumia forever."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "No... I don't want that."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: As she says this, some black substance begins to drip from her pale fingertips.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "That won't do; if I don't go home for too long, Mokou will get angry."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Hehehe, then you better hide quickly."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "If the grove withers, I'll disappear..."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The black substance drips onto the ground.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Are... are we supposed to start running for our lives now..."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "How about planting the grove right here?"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #A sudden blow to the head!
